extraction.summary_en: Decisions of the sole shareholder (HADEAN) of ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES dated 27 June 2008: (1) a pure division of the €100 nominal value into 100 shares of €1 (no capital change), (2) creation of two new preference-share classes (A, and B/B'), and (3) two capital increases in cash — Augmentation de Capital I (+€17,241, 17,241 Actions A at €5.80/share) and Augmentation de Capital II (+€150,861, 150,861 Actions B with attached BSOC at €5.80/share) — both subject to conditions but shown as realised in the updated statutes attached to the same filing, bringing capital from €200,000 to €368,102. The filing also records a registered-office transfer (out of scope) and includes the restated capital history since incorporation (2004: €37,000; 2005: €150,000; 2006: €200,000).

evidence.quote_fr: Le capital social est fixé à la somme de 368.102 euros. Il est divisé en 368.102 actions de 1 euro chacune entièrement libérées ... 217.241 actions de préférence de catégorie A, 150.861 actions de préférence de catégorie B.

issues: The 1st resolution (division of nominal value by 100) does not change capital or ownership percentages; per instructions no event was emitted for it, only recorded as a snapshot.

Resolution numbering in the OCR jumps (1,2,3,4,5,6, then 8, then 9, then 11, then 16, then 19), suggesting intermediate resolutions (7, 10, 12-15, 17-18) — likely dealing with suppression of preferential subscription rights and named beneficiaries — are missing from this extract; the actual subscribers of the Capital Increase I and II shares are not named anywhere in the provided text.

Both capital increases (I and II) were stated as conditional (suspensive conditions, open subscription period until 18 July 2008), but the same filing's updated statutes (dated 27 June 2008) already show the post-increase capital of €368,102, so they were treated as completed_here per the rule that co-filed updated statutes evidence realisation; however no explicit 'réalisation définitive' constat is present in the extract, only the updated article 7.
Article 7 of the updated statutes lists only Actions A and Actions B (217,241 + 150,861 = 368,102), with no Actions B' outstanding — consistent with B' being a conversion-only class not yet issued.

Price/premium arithmetic for Increase I (17,241 x 5.80 = 99,997.80, of which 82,756.80 is premium) and Increase II (150,861 x 5.80 = 874,993.80, of which 724,132.80 is premium, split 603,444 reserved + 271,549.80/271,549.90 to premium account — OCR shows both 271,549.90 and implied 271,549.80, a minor rounding/OCR discrepancy) are internally consistent enough to be considered reliable.
